verdict.rationale: Fly.io is a cloud hosting platform, not an AI agent or assistant, so acting as an MCP client that plugs in servers and calls their tools is the wrong axis for it. The MCP evidence covers other roles: hosting MCP servers in Sprites or Machines, and an experimental flyctl MCP server. Neither shows Fly.io itself consuming MCP tools, so neither makes this client-side story applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
